informal_statement:
For \(\lambda>0\), the functions \(D(z)\) and
\[
\sqrt{\lambda^2-z^2}/\lambda-\sqrt{1-z^2}
\]
agree at every real \(z\).
reason: Source `CMVElementary.lean:171-176`: The statement is equality of whole real functions, obtained by pointwise square-root normalization, not merely equality on the geometric interval.
